textbookText: A. Tick the correct alternative. 1. Which of the following broadly describes biology? a. Macrobiology b. Biotechnology c. Biochemistry d. Life Science 2. Why is biochemistry considered at the intersection of Biology and Chemistry? a. It studies the geological aspects of living organisms. b. It explores the relationship between animals and their environments. c. It addresses the chemical processes within living organisms. d. It focuses on the classification of different species. 3. What is the study of plants called in biology? a. Zoology b. Botany c. Microbiology d. Biotechnology 4. Which branch of biology does ichthyology deal with? a. fruit b. heart c. disease d. fish 5. Why do biologists focus on finding solutions to challenges such as radiation dangers and hunger? a. To control the population increase. b. To understand the origin of life. c. To address environmental pollution. d. To enhance human well-being and solve global issues. 6. Which branch of zoology focuses on the study of insects? a. Ichthyology b. Ornithology c. Entomology d. Anthropology 7. If a scientist is studying the internal structures of plants, which branch of biology are they likely specializing in? a. Morphology b. Anatomy c. Physiology d. Histology 8. Which branch of biology involves the study of geographical factors influencing the distribution of organisms? a. Bioinformatics b. Biogeography c. Biostatistics d. Biometrics 9. What field of biology is associated with the study of health and disease control? a. Biotechnology b. Paleontology c. Microbiology d. Epidemiology Biology, Grade 11 | 238
